name: extract-json
about: Fields pulled from your document (source.txt) into JSON (out.json) that fits your schema, with every value found in the document: text word for word, numbers equal to ones written there, YYYY-MM-DD dates written there in any form. Fields you name in `except` (a category you defined, a currency code) are derived, so skipped. Proves the shape and that nothing was invented, not that each value sits in the right field.
instructions: Reply with the JSON only. Copy text values exactly as the document writes them (same words and spelling, no paraphrase); write numbers as plain JSON numbers without currency signs or thousands separators, and dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out, or set to null, anything the document doesn't say — never guess.

schema.about: a JSON Schema for the result (the same subset json-schema takes)

except.about: comma-separated field names whose values are derived rather than copied (checked by the schema only)
